$comment: File-level patches, newest first. READ BY MACHINES - do not change the shape, only the values. 'base' is the version a patch upgrades FROM; an installation is offered only the patch whose base equals its running version, so intermediate versions can never be skipped. Publish one patch per step, or ship a full release. See SURUM_YAYINLAMA.md section 9.

Yama uygulandiktan sonra bayat konteynerle sayfa render edilmesi duzeltildi; basarisiz onbellek temizligi artik gorunur.
Cok dilli e-posta sablonlari, e-posta/kullanici adi degisikliginde yonetici onayi, itibar icin konu baglantisi, 404 log gurultusu.
